en_title: X-Men Actor Christopher Abbott Insists His Professor X Is Not in Doomsday or Secret Wars
cn_title: 《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》新版X教授演员否认参演两部《复联》
subtitle: 先拍完再谈客串
opus_summary: 新版X教授演员表示，自己不会参演接下来的两部《复仇者联盟》，必须先拍完《X战警》再谈客串。这部重启电影定于2028年5月5日上映，漫威影业已公布部分阵容。

paragraphs.en: Professor X actor Christopher Abbott said Marvel fans won't see him in Avengers: Doomsday or Secret Wars because he needs to wrap up his time with X-Men before doing any cameos.
paragraphs.cn: X教授的扮演者Christopher Abbott表示，漫威粉丝不会在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》或《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》中看到他，因为他得先拍完《X战警》，才能考虑客串。

paragraphs.en: The Marvel Cinematic Universe newcomer tried his best not to play coy during a conversation with Rolling Stone . When pressed on whether comic book fans will see his shaved head fighting against Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom at any point in the next year or so, he insisted he doesn't have any additional team-up movies on his plate for now.
paragraphs.cn: 这位漫威电影宇宙的新成员在接受《滚石》采访时，尽量把话说得直白。采访者追问，漫画迷是否会在未来一年左右看到他剃光头，与小罗伯特·唐尼饰演的毁灭博士交手。他坚称，目前自己没有参演其他超级英雄集结电影的安排。

paragraphs.en: "I don't think so," when asked if he'll appear in any cameo roles before X-Men. "I don't even know… See, what's happening? What do you mean?"
paragraphs.cn: 被问到是否会在《X战警》上映前客串其他作品时，他回答：「我想不会吧。我都不知道……你看，这是怎么回事？你指什么？」

paragraphs.en: Christopher Abbott, who will play Professor X in 2028's ‘X-Men’ reboot, says he will not be in the upcoming Avengers movie.
paragraphs.cn: 将在2028年《X战警》重启电影中饰演X教授的Christopher Abbott表示，他不会出演即将上映的《复仇者联盟》电影。

paragraphs.en: “I don't think so. Well, I don't even know–what's happening? What do you mean? I don't know what's going on. On no. I'm not in that. I gotta do the ‘X-Men’ movie first before any of that stuff.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我想不会吧。嗯，我都不知道——这是怎么回事？你指什么？我不知道是什么情况。哦，不。我没参演那部电影。在考虑那些事之前，我得先拍《X战警》。」

paragraphs.en: When the interviewer clarified, asking if he'll play in Doomsday, he had a quick reply: "No, I'm not in that."
paragraphs.cn: 采访者进一步说明，问他是否会出演《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》，他立刻答道：「没有，我没参演那部电影。」

paragraphs.en: Abbott joined a cast of other would-be mutant heroes when Marvel Studios confirmed he had been picked to play Professor X at D23 earlier this year. The announcement also came with a May 2028 release date, giving him plenty of time to prepare to play the group's leader, and if fans are lucky, show up for a scene or two beforehand.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，漫威影业在D23上确认由Abbott饰演X教授，他也就此加入了这批即将饰演变种人英雄的演员阵容。漫威同时宣布影片将于2028年5月上映，让他有充裕的时间为饰演这支队伍的领袖做准备。如果粉丝运气好，或许还能在那之前看到他露面一两场戏。

paragraphs.en: After all, Doomsday and Secret Wars aren't just your run-of-the-mill superhero flicks. These are saga-ending event films packed to the gills with A-listers and, of course, cameos to keep the MCU going well into the future. With the 2000s versions of the X-Men, including Patrick Stewart's version of Charles Xavier, having already shown up for a few Doomsday trailers, many have wondered if the new X-Men cast would show up on-screen before Marvel's 2027 slate launched. If Abbott is out, though, the chances of an early MCU debut for other X-Men (besides Sadie Sink's Jean Grey ) just got a little less likely.
paragraphs.cn: 毕竟，《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》和《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》并非普通的超级英雄电影。这两部为整个传奇收尾的重头戏集结了大批一线明星，当然也少不了为漫威电影宇宙后续发展铺路的客串角色。2000年代版本的X战警已经在几支《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》预告片中亮相，其中包括帕特里克·斯图尔特饰演的查尔斯·泽维尔。因此，不少人都想知道，新版《X战警》的演员是否会在漫威2027年的作品开始上映前登场。不过，如果Abbott不参演，其他X战警成员提前在漫威电影宇宙亮相的可能性也就又小了几分，Sadie Sink饰演的琴·葛蕾除外。

paragraphs.en: "I gotta do the X-Men movie first before any of that stuff," he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「在考虑那些事之前，我得先拍《X战警》。」

paragraphs.en: When the interviewer interjected, pointing out that hard launching characters without a cameo is "famously not how Marvel works," Abbott said with a chuckle, "Look, no coyness: I'm not in that movie."
paragraphs.cn: 采访者插话指出，不先安排客串就直接让角色正式登场，「众所周知，这可不是漫威的做法」。Abbott笑着说：「听着，我没在卖关子：我没参演那部电影。」

paragraphs.en: With Doomsday less than two months from its December 18, 2026, release date, it really does sound like Abbott won't show up. However, with more than a full year before Secret Wars follows come December 17, 2027, and no trailers out yet, who knows? At least as far as this new take on Professor X is concerned, it's best not to get hopes up too high in the meantime.
paragraphs.cn: 距离《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》2026年12月18日上映已不到两个月，听起来Abbott确实不会登场。不过，《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》要到2027年12月17日才会上映，距离现在还有一年多，预告片也尚未发布，谁又说得准呢？至少对于这位新版X教授，眼下最好还是别抱太高期待。

paragraphs.en: Set to join Abbott on the team are Inde Navarrette as Rogue, Maya Boyd as Storm, Asa Germann as Angel , and more. We'll at least see the X-Men team unite when the reboot premieres May 5, 2028. Until then, you can get a sneak peek at Navarrette's progress on developing Rogue's accent .
paragraphs.cn: 与Abbott一同组成这支队伍的演员还包括饰演小淘气的Inde Navarrette、饰演暴风女的Maya Boyd，以及饰演天使的Asa Germann等。至少等到这部重启电影于2028年5月5日上映时，我们就能看到X战警集结了。
